fichas.descripcion:
The Windsor is an Arketipo sofa with diamond-quilted, button-tufted upholstery, soft and welcoming to sit on. This italian sofa is made in Italy and comes upholstered in fabric, leather or velvet.

UPHOLSTERY OPTIONS

  • Fabric (category E).
  • Leather: Pelle A, Pelle B, Pelle Leonardo.
  • Velvet: Vellù in eight colorways.

TRADITIONAL OR CONTEMPORARY

The quilting and the button detail let the Windsor style sofa sit in a classic living room as easily as a modern one. An extra-large version is also available: pick it if you have the floor space for a longer sofa. Browse all sofas to compare versions and upholstery lines before you order.
fichas.descripcion_original: The Windsor Italian luxury designer sofa fits in with all kinds of furnitures: perfect in a Traditional setting, in a Contemporary setting it stands out like a valuable work of art. This Italian sofa with high-end tufted upholstery, has a decidedly distinctive feel. It is refined, luxurious and sophisticated, yet also soft and welcoming, due to the characteristic button buried in the diamond quilting of the padding. Windsor sofa has extended its range with an additional, extra-large sofa of 123″5/8. Besides, there is a new high-end version in velvet which gives the sofa a silky and sumptuous look.Made in Italy.

keywords_detalle.por_que: se busca con el nombre o el fabricante (10/mes; para llegar al mínimo de 3)

validacion.razon: Los datos coinciden con la ficha: tufted/diamond quilting, button detail, Made in Italy, categorías de tapizado (Fabric E, Pelle A/B/Leonardo, Vellù en 8 variantes contadas correctamente), versión extra-large y versatilidad traditional/contemporary. El H1 identifica el producto y su técnica distintiva (tufted), y las keywords se usan con el sentido de la ficha sin relleno llamativo.

The seams follow the curve of the headboard, and wooden details connect it to the bed frame. This Italian bed comes in Queen or King size.

Everything appears as a single and sinuous body. Soul bed is available in different finishes as per collection. Made in Italy.

SUN-BLEACHED COLOR

Each Venetian candle holder is blown by hand, so tone and silhouette vary slightly from one piece to the next. That faded, sun-bleached color sits well on a modern table and on a classic one. La variación de tono y silueta se deriva de 'each piece is unique' y la mención a interiores modernos y clásicos está respaldada. LIGHT, COLOR, SOUND AND SCENT

The stones version adds a Corian touch top with chromotherapy and aromatherapy, music and a cup warmer.

SINGLE OR DOUBLE

fichas.descripcion_original:
Inspired on the search of the best possible to create a balance between body, mind and soul, here is a sophisticated Italian customizable collection for wellness therapy and SPA that consists of a bed (single or double) resting on stones, feet or plexiglass support and a luminous ring. Stones available with Corian touch top with chromotherapy and aromatherapy function, music and cup warmer.

Wellness Therapy is an innovative furnishing system where light, color, sound and scent chase each other, creating an experience of relaxation that is not only form and ergonomics, but in which emotion and holistic sensoriality also come into play. Designed by Varaschin. Made in Italy.

See the “Data Sheet” PDF for technical information.

validacion.razon: Todos los datos coinciden con la ficha: colección personalizable para wellness/SPA, cama single o double sobre piedras, patas o soporte de plexiglás, anillo luminoso, versión stones con Corian, cromoterapia, aromaterapia, música y calientatazas, fabric Abaco en nueve colores (C471–C479) y Made in Italy. El H1 identifica el producto (lounger) con su rasgo distintivo (anillo luminoso) y la marca.
